from itertools import combinations

n = int(input())
segments = list(map(int, input().split()))
k = int(input())

count = 0
for combo in combinations(range(n), k):
    sides = [segments[i] for i in combo]
    sides.sort()
    # Check polygon inequality: sum of all sides except largest > largest side
    if sum(sides[:-1]) > sides[-1]:
        count += 1

print(count)
